statement: Build a single-page website for Thread & Loom, a handloom clothing boutique in Pune, where visitors can browse the shop's products, check sizes and prices, see what is new and place an order on WhatsApp.
audience: Shoppers in and around Pune, mostly on phones, looking for handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas.
standards: Earthy and elegant look: natural, warm colours and a refined typeface
Designed for phones first, and also good on a desktop screen
Prices shown in rupees (₹) exactly as given by the Requester
Only facts supplied by the Requester appear on the site; nothing invented
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
rules: Use the Requester's product list, prices, sizes, timings, address, phone numbers, policy, size guide and reviews exactly as given
Products have no photos yet: show clearly marked empty photo spots instead
Lookbook outfits may only combine products from the product list
Reviews show the first name and initial given by the Requester
done_when: The page shows the name Thread & Loom, mentions Pune, and has a menu that links to each section of the page

The product list shows exactly these 10 products in four categories, with names and prices in ₹: Kurtas (Indigo block-print kurta 1,499; Mustard handloom kurta 1,699; White chikankari kurta 2,199), Sarees (Maheshwari cotton saree 3,499; Chanderi silk-cotton saree 4,999; Ikat handloom saree 3,999), Shirts (Khadi cotton shirt 1,299; Linen-blend shirt 1,599), Dupattas (Ajrakh dupatta 899; Bandhani dupatta 1,099), and visitors can pick a category to view

Visitors can filter products by size and by price, and the sizes per product match: Indigo kurta S-XXL, Mustard kurta S-XL, White chikankari kurta XS-XL, Khadi shirt S-XXL, Linen-blend shirt M-XXL; sarees and dupattas are free size
A size guide table lists chest measurements in inches: XS 32, S 34, M 36, L 38, XL 40, XXL 42
A New Arrivals section shows exactly: White chikankari kurta, Ikat handloom saree, Linen-blend shirt
Each product has an order button that opens WhatsApp for +91 00000 11111 with the product name in the message
A Lookbook section shows 3 styled outfits, each built only from products in the list, with an empty photo spot for each

A section shows the store timings (11am to 9pm, Tuesday to Sunday, closed Monday), the address (18 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune 411005), the shop phone +91 00000 22222, and a link that opens the address in a map
A section states the return and exchange policy: exchange within 7 days if unworn with tags, no returns on sale items
A Reviews section shows these 3 reviews with names: "Beautiful fabric, fits perfectly" - Meera K.; "Fast delivery and lovely packing" - Arjun S.; "My go-to for festive kurtas" - Priya D.
A delivery note states: across Pune in 2 days, ₹79, free above ₹2,999, pay on delivery or UPI
Every product has a clearly marked empty photo spot
The page has a mobile viewport setting, no horizontal scrolling at 360px and 1280px widths, no JavaScript errors, and no in-page link pointing to a missing section
visitor_needs: See a lookbook of styled outfits
Read the return and exchange policy
Know delivery charges and payment options
